content:
Hello. Good afternoon and Happy Friday!

I saw that this PR was recently moved to the 6.15 milestone: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pull/12783
I am assuming 6.15 is at least a year away
I will not be able to merge the JSF test suite into the upstream repo until I am able to normalize the testing harness first

I realize that this is a monster of a PR. I am completely fine if it is rejected. Is there anything I can do to convince the team to process this faster or make this a priority? If I merge the test suite now (in Java) then I'll have to abandon this PR because there's too many changes

Yeah, @Ceilyn Boyd and I moved it. Please don't read too much into it! We also added "Should Have" under "FY Priority".

In which milestone would you like this to land?

We're less than a month away from code freeze for 6.13! Please see #community > Release 6.13 Timeline.
I would like for the JSF test suite to be merged as quickly as possible into upstream

If this PR is a blocker, I'll consider it abandoned and make the merge PR for the test suite immediately next week and try to have it in either before the 6.13 code freeze or for 6.14. I will not be able to keep this PR alive for a year, we can revisit it some time in the future.
Let me put it this way. We have so many open PRs (which is a good thing, in a way!) that we get a little lost. Are you saying #12783 is the one to merge first?
Sorry, I probably should've given more context. Yes, ideally 12783 would need to be merged first

It's not necessary, but its ideal. If its done the other way around (JSF test suite merged first, then 12783) then I won't be able to bring 12783 back into sync, and I'll have to put it on the back burner. Essentially, I'm asking if the team has bandwidth to review this in 6.13 or 6.14

If the answer is a clear no, then I'll put 12783 aside and focus on getting the JSF tests merged into the main repo. I hope that makes sense. They conflict because currently the JSF tests are in gdcc/dataverse-jsf-tests and after they're moved into the main repo, all the references and locations have to be changed.

Let me know if this makes sense
Cool, thanks. I just assigned myself, put it in "in review", and switched the milestone to 6.13.
Thank you! I hope I'm not creating too much review burden
These milestones aren't set in stone, obviously. :smile:
Also, the squeaky wheel gets the grease! :smile:
If the PR is structurally sound, its going to benefit all of us!
Absolutely.
@Ash Manda can you please take a look at this failing test? https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pull/12783/changes#r4497541905
considering the same test passes in Firefox and Chrome, I might just retrigger the tests

I'm running into: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/issues/12679

The video shows it very clearly. I thought it was just a race condition, but it happened twice

I'll make the test more tolerant, but it looks like this bug hasn't gone away.
fixed the test.
Here, it looks like: https://github.com/gdcc/dataverse-jsf-tests/commit/ec257436a2baf2d24c3fd353ff1a342370d270ff
@Ash Manda I just merged #12783! Thanks!
@Oliver Bertuch heads up that I had to dismiss your review to merge.
